ljcr-coverdata-459bcaf.notes: Gordon LJCR covering table JSON snapshot. Live sites ljcr.dmgordon.org and dmgordon.org/cover are unreachable (DNS failure / 404).

oeis-A118771.notes: OEIS A118771: Weak Schur numbers (convention: smallest s without sum-free partition).

oeis-A072842.notes: OEIS A072842: Weak Schur numbers (convention: largest m with valid partition). Cites Rowley (2025) WS(5)>=207 and Rodrigo (2026) WS(6)>=650.

oeis-A030126.notes: OEIS A030126: Schur numbers (version 1, smallest s without partition). Cites Heule (2017) S(5)=160 exact partition.

oeis-A090245.notes: OEIS A090245: Maximum cap set size in F3^n. Cites Romera-Paredes et al. (2024) FunSearch cap set.

zenodo-20633634.notes: Sebastián E. Rodrigo (2026): A new lower bound for the sixth weak Schur number: WS(6) >= 650 with witness digits archive.

fredricksen-sweet-2000.notes: Harold Fredricksen and Melvin M. Sweet (2000): Symmetric Sum-Free Partitions and Lower Bounds for Schur Numbers. Shows S(6)>=536 and S(7)>=1680.

funsearch-nature-2024.notes: Romera-Paredes et al. (Nature 2024): Mathematical discoveries from program search with LLMs. Cap set in F3^8 of size 512.

edel-caps-tables.notes: Yves Edel: Generator matrices for caps and table of lower bounds.

edel-248-7-3.notes: Yves Edel: Generator matrix of 248-cap in PG(7,3) containing Calderbank-Fishburn 236-cap in AG(7,3).
